''See also: [[Pilgrim Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Pilgrims]] are members of the [[Luminian Order]], a disciplined organization characterized by its silver-armored knights and its many white-clad members. They are easily identified by their pristine white clothing and silver medallions featuring the [[White Sun]], a symbol of their order. These individuals often serve as healers or protectors, and some possess the ability to create barriers of light. While many [[Pilgrims]] use alchemy and medical expertise to heal, more powerful members can become [[Soulbound]], a status achieved only after years of service and successfully opposing various [[Elders]]. The most elite [[Pilgrims]] carry medallions that act as Beacons, serving as focuses for immense restorative and light-based power. The order is led by a [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]], such as [[Jameson Allbright]], who wears distinct ceremonial attire. Historically, the role is rooted in the legacy of [[Loreli]], Daughter of the Emperor, who was considered the first Pilgrim. Though they are viewed as symbols of righteousness and light, some [[Pilgrims]] may develop an intense religious zeal due to the [[Awakening]] process, while others may fail to fully bond with their medallions.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Pilgrim is a man dressed in white robes. He also wears a medallion featuring the [[White Sun]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Pilgrim addresses [[Darius Allbright|Darius]] by the title of [[Knight-Adjunct]]. Additionally, [[Shera]] issues an order for [[the Reader]] to be brought before a Pilgrim.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Pilgrims]] of the [[Luminian Order]] utilize alchemy and medical skill to heal others. To possess [[Soulbound]] power, they must serve the [[Guild]] for years and oppose [[Elders]].}}
